description: Add one or more tasks to the end of an existing trip checklist. Get checklist_id from trip_checklists. Each item has text and an optional category (the section heading it appears under). A checklist holds at most 100 tasks; tasks are a flat list with no subtasks. Calling this twice adds the tasks twice. To create a new checklist use segment_create (type Note, isChecklist true). Never show IDs to users.

checklist_id.description: The checklist note's segment ID (checklist_id from trip_checklists).

category.description: Optional section heading, e.g. Clothing or Documents.

name: checklist_items_add
title: Add Checklist Items
